amb_bunker_bed.description: Bunker room tone: ventilation rumble, distant machinery thrum, faint mains tone (stereo 20 s loop).

dispenser_thunk.description: Pneumatic tube canister arriving: rising rush, thunk, air release hiss.

distant_impact.description: Deep structural boom from far away, long dark tail.

fluorescent_flicker.description: Fluorescent tube flickering: starter tick + stuttering buzz bursts.

fluorescent_hum_loop.description: Fluorescent tube: 100 Hz mains hum + ballast buzz (4 s loop).

gate_alarm.description: Gate warning: two-tone alarm beep through a horn speaker (exactly 1 s, loopable).

gate_motor_loop.description: Heavy gate drive: electric motor whine, gearbox, chain rattle, rolling rumble (3 s loop).

gate_start.description: Gate start: relay contactor clunk then motor spinning up, chain engages.

gate_stop.description: Gate stop: motor winds down, heavy reverberant steel clank.

generator_loop.description: Diesel generator idling (750 rpm 4-cyl thrum, injector clatter, 4 s loop).

lever_pull.description: Heavy lever pulled: ratchet pawl clicks then a solid clunk.

purchase.description: Mechanical cash register 'ka-chunk', drawer roll and bell.

radio_burst.description: Radio interference burst with garbled, voice-like babble that warps unsettlingly.

radio_static_loop.description: Radio static: band-limited hiss, crackle and a wandering heterodyne whistle (4 s loop).

sell_vacuum.description: Pneumatic tube suction: seal pop, roaring whoosh away, distant thunk.

spark.description: Electrical spark: sharp snap with arcing crackle tail.

structural_creak.description: Metal structure under stress: slow stick-slip groan.

terminal_boot.description: Old CRT terminal boot: relay, degauss thoom, flyback whine, POST beeps.

terminal_type.description: Single mechanical keyboard keystroke (down + bottom-out + release).

vent_loop.description: Air vent: duct hiss, fan blade tone and a loose louver rattle (6 s loop).

water_drip_bunker.description: Water drip in the bunker (puddle / on metal).

boar_charge.description: Boar charging: snorting rush and drumming hooves, angry grunts, getting closer.

boar_grunt.description: Boar: low nasal grunts, sometimes with a snort.

boar_squeal.description: Boar squeal: shrill, harsh pig scream.

borer_dig_loop.description: Borer digging: rhythmic churning crunch of rock (2 s loop).

borer_emerge.description: Borer bursting out of the rock: explosion of stone, rubble cascade, roar onset.

borer_grind_loop.description: Borer: deep vibrating grinding vocal with rock grind (3 s loop).

borer_hurt.description: Borer hurt: grinding bellow breaking upward, rock shudder.

borer_impact_close.description: Borer: closer, louder impact under the floor - rock crack and heavy debris fall.

borer_impact_deep.description: Borer: huge low thump from beneath the floor, sub-bass with falling grit.

borer_roar.description: Borer roar: enormous grinding, distorted bellow.

borer_step.description: Borer footfall: very heavy, ground-shaking crunch.

clerk_click_loop.description: Ceiling Clerk: soft wet jaw clicking (2 s loop).

clerk_drop.description: Ceiling Clerk dropping from the ceiling: rush, heavy body thud, limbs clattering.

clerk_hiss.description: Ceiling Clerk hiss: breathy throat hiss with jaw clicks.

clerk_hurt.description: Ceiling Clerk hurt: raspy yelp and rapid jaw clicks.

clerk_jaw_drop.description: Ceiling Clerk unhinging its jaw: wet click then a long cartilage creak.

clerk_screech.description: Ceiling Clerk grab: dry, raspy, inhaled vocal-fry screech with clicks.

clerk_skitter.description: Ceiling Clerk: rapid finger-drumming tapping run (wood / stone).

clerk_tap.description: Ceiling Clerk: a single fingernail tap (1-3 wood, 4-6 stone).

dust_fall.description: Sprinkle of grit and dust falling from the ceiling.

fk_death.description: Falsekin death: shriek collapsing into a gurgle, last twitching clicks.

fk_hiss.description: Falsekin hiss with a chitinous mandible rattle.

fk_mimic.description: Falsekin mimicking a rabbit: sniff/chitter that slows, detunes and goes wrong.

fk_reveal.description: Falsekin reveal (key sound): stretching, tearing, wet bone cracks, then a rising ring-modulated screech.

fk_shriek.description: Falsekin shriek: harsh, detuned, ring-modulated scream.

fk_skitter_loop.description: Falsekin skittering: very fast clicky multi-leg footsteps (2 s loop).

gaunt_step.description: Gaunt: enormous distant footfall rolling through the valley.

hb_alert.description: Hollowback alert: sharp wet rattling intake then a teeth click.

hb_attack.description: Hollowback lunge: ragged, choking roar with wet stutters (not a scream).

hb_breath_loop.description: Hollowback: slow, wet, rattling breaths (6 s loop).

hb_chase_loop.description: Hollowback chasing: fast, ragged, wet panting with grunts (3 s loop).

hb_hurt.description: Hollowback hurt: choked yelp breaking upwards, wet cough.

hb_scrape.description: Hollowback dragging long nails down tree bark.

hb_slap.description: Hollowback palm slapping the ground while galloping: wet fleshy 'pa-tap' (signature).

hb_warning.description: Hollowback warning: low gurgling growl rising in pitch and intensity.

mourner_buzz_loop.description: Lantern Mourner: electrical interference buzz near the creature (2 s loop).

mourner_clink.description: Lantern Mourner: broken lamp glass and metal fragments clinking.

mourner_hum_loop.description: Lantern Mourner: eerie breathy nasal hum, pitch slowly wavering (6 s loop).

mourner_reach.description: Lantern Mourner reaching: the hum rises into a thin, whistling shriek.

mourner_recoil.description: Lantern Mourner recoiling: electric crackle and a pained falling moan.

mourner_wail.description: Lantern Mourner: very distant, sad, falling wail.

rabbit_hop.description: Rabbit hop: soft double thump on the forest floor.

rabbit_thump.description: Rabbit warning: hard hind-foot thump on the ground.

rat_scurry.description: Gloomrat scurrying: tiny claws ticking and scratching.

amb_forest_bed.description: Night forest: gusting wind through branches and needles, leaf rustle, very sparse distant life (stereo 30 s loop).

amb_forest_insects_loop.description: Crickets and insect chorus layer (stereo 15 s loop) - muted near threats.

bird_flutter.description: Bird startled off a branch: leaf rustle then wingbeats flying away.

branch_snap.description: Twig / branch cracking somewhere out in the dark (near to far).

crow_caw.description: Crow cawing from a tree: harsh, rough 'kaaw'.

distant_call.description: Unidentifiable animal far away: owl-like, fox-like, a bark, and one that is slightly wrong.

footsteps_foliage.description: Something heavy stepping slowly into undergrowth.

frogs_loop.description: Frogs calling around a pond, near and far (mono 8 s loop).

stream_loop.description: Babbling forest stream: bubbling water texture (mono 6 s loop).

wind_gust.description: A gust of wind swelling through the trees, leaves stirring.

amb_mine_bed.description: Mine tunnels: low rumble, distant cave drips, slow air movement (stereo 30 s loop).

amb_mine_deep_bed.description: Deep mine: darker sub-bass pressure, faint distant metallic stress groans and pings (stereo 30 s loop).

drip.description: Cave water drip into a pool (short cave early reflections).

electrical_buzz_loop.description: Faulty junction box: harsh 100 Hz buzz with arcing crackle (2 s loop).

elevator_arrive.description: Elevator arrives: heavy cage stop clank, then the old arrival bell.

elevator_clank.description: Elevator cage clanking against its guides.

elevator_motor_loop.description: Mine elevator hoist motor running, cable creak and cage rattle (3 s loop).

footsteps_echo.description: Phantom footsteps somewhere down the tunnel, reverberant.

light_buzz_on.description: Work light switching on: relay click, filament surge buzz, thermal tink.

machinery_hum_loop.description: Heavy mine machinery hum: motor, transformer, gear whine (4 s loop).

metal_impact_distant.description: A metallic bang far away down the tunnels.

metal_impact_repeat.description: Three identical metal bangs, each one farther away.

minecart_roll.description: Mine cart rolling past: rail joint clacks, rumble, wheel squeal, rattle.

rock_fall_large.description: Larger rockfall: heavy chunks, rumble and rubble.

rock_fall_small.description: A few pebbles falling and bouncing.

scratch_metal.description: Claws scraping the other side of a metal plate (muffled, ringing).

walkway_steps.description: Footsteps on metal grating walkway: clang and rattle.

wall_knock.description: Knocking on the rock wall from the other side.

warning_recording.description: Old PA announcement: chime, then a distorted robotic voice babble that cuts off abruptly mid-word.

water_trickle_loop.description: Thin trickle of water down rock (mono 5 s loop).

whisper_air.description: Breathy air movement in the tunnel that could almost be a whisper.

sting_dread.description: Low dread swell: dissonant low cluster crescendo with opening filter (stereo 5 s).

sting_lore.description: Mysterious lore sting: inharmonic glass bells over a soft unresolved pad (stereo 3 s).

sting_purchase.description: Bright short purchase jingle: marimba / bell arpeggio (stereo 1 s).

sting_reveal.description: Dissonant reveal hit: impact, tritone brass cluster, screeching high strings (stereo 2.5 s).

sting_safe.description: Soft warm chord on returning to the bunker (stereo 4 s).

tension_drone_loop.description: Low pulsing chase drone (stereo 12 s seamless loop, 120 bpm pulse).

backpack_store.description: Item pushed into canvas backpack, zip closes.

backpack_take.description: Backpack zip opens, rummage, item pulled out.

body_scrape.description: Monkey body sliding along rock: grit, fur and stone friction.

breath_panic_loop.description: Fast, shaky panicked breathing with small whimpers (seamless 4 s loop).

death_sting.description: Player death: dark distorted impact followed by a falling detuned moan into darkness (3 s).

eat_munch.description: Chewing: crunchy bites turning wet, heard from inside the head.

grab.description: Soft hand closing on an object.

hand_tap_foliage.description: Hand pushing into leaves: leafy crinkle rustle.

hand_tap_ground.description: Hand slapping soft dirt: low padded thump + grit.

hand_tap_metal.description: Ringing clank of a hand hitting a metal panel.

hand_tap_mud.description: Wet squelch of a hand in mud, with suction release.

hand_tap_rock.description: Dull click/thud on rock with a little grit.

hand_tap_wood.description: Hollow wooden knock under a palm/knuckle.

heartbeat_loop.description: Muffled double-beat heartbeat, 70 bpm, 5 beats (seamless loop, 4.29 s).

holster_snap.description: Tool clipped into holster: leather slap + metal press-stud snap.

hurt_grunt.description: Short pained monkey vocal ('hoo' / 'ack'), formant synthesis.

land_thud.description: Monkey body landing on the ground: feet then hands, fur rustle.

whoosh.description: Fast arm / tool swing through air.

battery_low.description: Weak, sagging double beep: battery low.

flare_burn_loop.description: Burning flare: hissing, sputtering crackle (seamless 3 s loop).

flare_ignite.description: Road flare struck: scratch, fwoomph ignition, sputtering into hiss.

flashlight_flicker_loop.description: Failing flashlight: intermittent contact buzz and crackle (seamless 2 s loop).

glowstick_crack.description: Glowstick bent: plastic creak, inner glass vial snaps, liquid shake.

item_drop_metal.description: Small metal item dropped: clank and bounces.

item_drop_soft.description: Soft item (food / cloth) dropped: padded thump.

item_drop_stone.description: Stone / ore chunk dropped: knock, bounce, grit.

item_drop_wood.description: Wooden item dropped: knock and bounces.

marker_deploy.description: Marker beacon stuck into the ground (thunk) then arming beep.

medkit_use.description: Medkit: latches snap, lid opens, bandage wrapped, tape torn.

noisemaker_rattle.description: Tin can full of bolts shaken hard: loud metallic rattle.

ore_break.description: Ore deposit stage breaking: crack + crumble of chunks.

ore_break_final.description: Ore deposit final collapse: big crack, rumble and rubble.

ore_pickup.description: Picking up an ore chunk: stone clink against stone.

pick_hit_anomalous.description: Pickaxe on anomalous ore: wet organic squelch with a low unnatural throbbing tone.

pick_hit_blackstone.description: Pickaxe on blackstone: dead, dull, swallowed thud, almost no ring.

pick_hit_copper.description: Pickaxe on copper ore: softer, warmer metallic tone.

pick_hit_crystal.description: Pickaxe on crystal: glassy chime with a sinking, beating, subtly wrong resonance.

pick_hit_iron.description: Pickaxe on iron ore: metallic ring over the stone crack.

pick_hit_rock.description: Pickaxe on plain rock: sharp stone crack, chips skittering.

pick_miss_metal.description: Pick glancing off metal: short screeching scrape.

rope_unroll.description: Climbing rope thrown down / unrolling: fibre rustle and coil flops.

scanner_beep_strong.description: Ore scanner strong signal: brighter rapid double beep.

spear_hit_hard.description: Spear tip striking stone/hard surface; shaft buzzes in the hand.

spear_hit_wood.description: Spear thunking into wood; shaft wobbles.

spear_stab_flesh.description: Spear stab into flesh: swish, wet puncture, gristle crunch.
